record.question: She adjusted quite well with her husband’s idiosyncrasies
record.explanation: Answer A: peculiar habits. Idiosyncrasies are characteristics or habits peculiar to an individual. “Peculiar habits” directly matches; such habits need not be bad behaviour, sins or weaknesses. Reference: https://dictionary.apa.org/idiosyncrasy. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
